name: converter-hub
description: Local-first file converters: split spreadsheets and extract database dumps, entirely in the browser

scripts.build: bun run --filter @sql-extractor/core build && bun run --filter sql-extractor build && bun run --filter web build
scripts.test: bun run --filter @sql-extractor/core test && bun run --filter sql-extractor test && bun run --filter web test
scripts.typecheck: bun run --filter @sql-extractor/core typecheck && bun run --filter sql-extractor typecheck && bun run --filter web typecheck
